project.name: <project identifier, e.g. PROJ_26_001>
project.description: <one-sentence technical description of what this Ansible project configures and deploys>

connection.ssh_user: <default OS user for the VM image, e.g. debian, ubuntu, centos>

jump_server.group: <ansible group name that is the jump/bastion host>
jump_server.ssh_user: <SSH user for the jump server — often same as ssh_user>
jump_server.ansible_ssh_common_args: <ProxyCommand template applied to non-jump groups, e.g. "-o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o ProxyCommand='ssh -W %h:%p -i {{ ssh_private_key_file }} -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o IdentitiesOnly=yes {{ ssh_user }}@{{ jump_server_host }}'">

dynamic_inventory.terraform_project_path: <relative path from ansible project root to the Terraform BASE directory — parent of shared/ and env subdirs (e.g. dev/, stg/, prod/), e.g. ../terraform>

groups.name: <group name>
groups.description: <what VMs are in this group and their role>

playbooks.name: <playbook identifier>
playbooks.description: <what this playbook does and when to run it>
extra_vars: <var names expected at runtime, e.g. image_tag, target_env>

roles.name: <role name>
handlers: <handler name — triggered by notify in tasks>
required_vars: <var names that must be supplied — have no safe default>

vault_vars: <sensitive variable names to be stored in ansible-vault>

ansible_cfg.inventory: <inventory source path relative to project root, e.g. inventory/dynamic_inventory.sh>
ansible_cfg.ssh_args: <additional SSH args not related to ProxyJump — leave empty if none>

extractor_notes: <Decision or assumption made during extraction — include rationale>
